title: Luke Bible Quiz - Chapter 11
description: Ten questions on Luke 11: teaching on prayer, the friend at midnight, the sign of Jonah and the woes to the Pharisees.

questions.text: What did one of the disciples ask him in a certain place?
questions.explanation: One of his disciples asked him to teach them to pray, just as John also taught his disciples.

answers.text: To give them a sign from heaven
To explain the parable of the sower

questions.text: In the prayer he taught, what are they to ask for day by day?
questions.explanation: The prayer asks, "Give us day by day our daily bread."

questions.text: How many loaves of bread does the man in the story ask his friend for at midnight?
questions.explanation: The man says, "Friend, lend me three loaves of bread," because a friend has come to him from a journey.

questions.text: What does he say will happen to the one who keeps asking, seeking and knocking?
questions.explanation: He says that everyone who asks receives, he who seeks finds, and to him who knocks it will be opened.

answers.text: He receives, finds, and it is opened to him
He will be sent away empty-handed
He must first bring his friend a gift
He will be answered only at daybreak

questions.text: Which three things does he say a father would not give his son who asks for food?
questions.explanation: He asks whether a father would give a stone instead of bread, a snake instead of a fish, or a scorpion instead of an egg.

answers.text: Bread, a fish and an egg
A thorn, a stone and a cup
A stone, a snake and a scorpion

questions.text: What does he say the heavenly Father will give to those who ask him?
questions.explanation: He says that if evil people know how to give good gifts to their children, how much more will the heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him.

questions.text: What did some people say about how he cast out demons?
questions.explanation: Some of them said that he casts out demons by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.

answers.text: By Beelzebul, the prince of the demons

questions.text: What does he say happens to every kingdom divided against itself?
questions.explanation: He says that every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation, and a house divided against itself falls.

answers.text: It is given to its enemies to rule
It is restored by its king

questions.text: What sign does he say will be given to this generation?
questions.explanation: He says that no sign will be given to this evil generation but the sign of Jonah, the prophet.

questions.text: What did the Pharisee marvel at when his guest sat at the table?
questions.explanation: The Pharisee marveled that his guest had not first washed himself before dinner.

answers.text: That he ate with tax collectors
That he taught on the Sabbath
That he took the best seat
That he had not first washed before dinner
